# agentsbox
Tool-search facade for MCP servers (OpenCode + pi integrations)

## PURPOSE
Reduce LLM context bloat by exposing only 6 stable tools that search/execute MCP server tools on-demand. Full MCP tool surface accessible via search.

## TOOL SURFACE (6 tools always visible)
- agentsbox_search_bm25(text, limit?): Search tools by natural language
- agentsbox_search_regex(pattern, limit?): Search tools by regex on tool names
- agentsbox_execute(toolId, arguments?): Execute discovered tool
- agentsbox_status(): Get status (servers, tools, health)
- agentsbox_perf(): Get performance metrics
- agentsbox_test(timeout?): Test all tools with minimal inputs

## TOOLID FORMAT
toolId = {serverName}_{toolName}
Server names MUST NOT contain underscores (enforced constraint)
Examples: time_get_current_time, brave_web_search, tavily_search

## WORKFLOW
1. Search: agentsbox_search_bm25({text: "intent description"}) OR agentsbox_search_regex({pattern: "server_.*"})
2. Execute: agentsbox_execute({toolId: "server_tool", arguments: '{"key":"value"}'})

## SEARCH STRATEGY
- Use regex when: know server name OR partial tool name (faster)
- Use bm25 when: know what you want to do but NOT tool name (semantic)
- Fallback chain: regex → bm25 → status → ask user
- Discovery patterns:
  - List all: regex({pattern: ".*"})
  - Server tools: regex({pattern: "serverName_.*"})
  - Free search: bm25({text: "keywords"})

## CONFIGURATION
- Path: ~/.config/agentsbox/config.jsonc (or AGENTSBOX_CONFIG env)
- Env interpolation: {env:VAR_NAME} → process.env.VAR_NAME
- MCP servers:
  - local: {type: "local", command: ["uvx", "server"], environment: {...}}
  - remote: {type: "remote", url: "https://...", headers: {...}}
- Settings: defaultLimit (number), initMode ("eager"|"lazy"), connection timeouts

## INITIALIZATION
- eager: connect all servers in background immediately after plugin load (default)
- lazy: connect only when first search/execute requested
- Thread-safe: multiple concurrent searches share one initialization

## ARCHITECTURE
Components: ToolSurface → SearchLayer (BM25+regex) → Catalog → MCPManager → MCPServers(local/remote)
Search: BM25Index for semantic, regex for pattern matching
Catalog: unified tool representation from all servers, indexed incrementally
MCPManager: connection mgmt (eager/lazy), tool call routing, error handling, retries

## ERROR HANDLING
Search returns empty: check servers connected via status(), verify tools indexed
Execute fails: check toolId format, validate arguments against schema, check server health
Error response format: {success: false, error: string, server: {name, status, error}}

## PERFORMANCE
BM25 search: <10ms, Regex: <5ms, Tool execution: 50-500ms (server dependent)
Memory: ~150KB per 100 tools (catalog + index), ~1MB per MCP client
Optimization: use regex for known patterns, limit search results, appropriate timeouts

## AGENT BEHAVIOR RULES
- ALWAYS search before saying "I cannot do that"
- ALWAYS search if user wants to use tools or refers to unknown tool names
- Use regex for known prefixes, bm25 for semantic search
- Get schema from search result before building arguments
- Handle errors gracefully, provide helpful feedback
- Use status() for diagnostics, test() to verify tools, perf() for performance issues

## INTEGRATIONS
- OpenCode: plugin via agentsbox/setup opencode → ~/.config/opencode/plugins/agentsbox.js
- pi: extension via agentsbox/setup pi → ~/.pi/agent/extensions/agentsbox
- CLI: agentsbox init (config+schema+skill), agentsbox setup <target> (install integration)

## KEY TYPES
CatalogTool: {idString, serverName, name, description, inputSchema}
SearchResult: {idString, preview, score}
Config: {mcp: Record<string, MCPServerConfig>, settings: Settings}
MCPServerConfig: {type: "local"|"remote", command?, url?, headers?, environment?}

## TESTING
agentsbox_test({timeout: 10000}) executes every tool with minimal predefined inputs, returns pass/fail
Use to verify tool availability before execution attempts

## TROUBLESHOOTING
status() → check servers.connected, tools.total, health.status
perf() → check initDuration, searchLatency, executionLatency
test() → identify broken tools
Common: server not connected (check config), toolId format wrong (need underscore), arguments invalid (check schema)

## CODEBASE STRUCTURE
src/catalog/ - tool catalog + types
src/config/ - config loading + validation
src/mcp-client/ - MCP manager (local/remote/fake)
src/search/ - BM25 + regex search
src/profiler/ - performance tracking
src/runtime.ts - core runtime + tool registration
src/plugin.ts - OpenCode plugin
src/pi.ts - pi extension
src/cli.ts - CLI (init/setup)
